name: app-tablet-dashboard-on-violet-cushions
title: Analytics tablet resting on puffy violet cushions
whatItIs: A tablet with a light analytics dashboard lies on quilted violet fabric cushions, lit softly, with a purple gradient at the corner.
whatItMeans: Soft, comfortable and surprising; the plush fabric makes a data tool feel friendly.
techniques: Set a functional screen on an unexpected soft material to create contrast.
Match the environment to the UI's accent colour (violet) for cohesion.
Photograph at an angle with shallow depth so the screen recedes naturally.
Keep the UI light so it glows against the saturated scene.

vocabulary.definition: Placing a UI in a stylised physical scene.
A scene composed in a single hue family.
Pairing a hard technical object with a soft texture.
Blur in foreground and background to focus on the subject.
